capabilities: Export notes as branded PDF reports with cover page, header/footer bands and table of contents
Write the same report as a .docx, laid out like the PDF or filled into a company .dotx template
Remove confidential passages per audience profile before rendering, fail-closed
Create, duplicate and share report templates as self-contained JSON files
Mark reports with TLP levels in footers and reminder pages
extras: Renamed from PDF Report Exporter at version 2.0 (plugin id, settings and commands unchanged); desktop only; free with no paid tier; fonts bundled so main.js is about 5 MB and CJK/Arabic scripts will not render.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to produce a polished, branded PDF or Word report from a note, or to strip internal passages for a client-facing version.

summary: Template-driven exporter that turns notes into branded PDF and Word reports with cover pages, tables of contents, callouts, Mermaid diagrams and audience profiles.
